answer: Last month a reviewer waved through 60 junk answers because his stake was 20 POA against a 300 POA payout, so collateral now splits across three unrelated auditors and a spot check re-grades one task in ten. Trust attaches to the task, not the address: a new identity with one verified task outranks a mesa of old accounts with none. A farm must buy real work per seat, and its summit arrives before any relic reputation can be reused.
